items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: I knew about Charlie Charleston; I knew about Johnny Dunn but I -

ctx.x: Normal, Alabama, N-o-r-m-a-l. See because right out from that was the Seventh Day Adventists that later on a lot of peoples joined that. It's Huntsville, J.F. Drake, Alabama, they say, and later on Professor Jack (Tfadrick?) became the Professor. But Mr. James H. Wilson, he had been with the 24th and he had been with the 10th Cavalry and he was a flexible man. He was the one that told me about Louis Armstrong; but here's a man that's playing classical music, what does he know about Louis Armstrong? I knew about…
